verdict.rationale: Wrike is a work-management and project-collaboration platform, not an AI coding agent, so restoring a coding agent's session to a prior checkpoint is outside its product category. Its documented AI agents handle workflow tasks such as triaging and risk assessment, not coding sessions. Attachment versioning is an unrelated feature and does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history
